verdict: labelled frames of the bed between prints
printer: Prusa CORE One+ (HF0.4), smooth PEI sheet, camera via go2rtc (1280x720)
purpose: what an agent should conclude from a look before it asks for start-print: every print in this session was started only after a person or the agent had confirmed the bed was clear on the camera

expected_agent_action.not_clear: do not start the print: tell a person what is on the bed and where

what_varies: the bed's height (lowered at the bottom of the frame, or raised close to the camera where it fills the frame and bends at the edges), where the head is parked, the reflections on the sheet, and the printed centre lines and logo that are part of the sheet rather than debris

frames.label: clear
frames.note: the print has started and is heating; the red dot at the back left is an indicator light, not debris

frames.label: clear
frames.note: before spaghetti-debris-warning, after a person removed the strand in not-clear-01

frames.label: not clear, subtle
frames.note: one short dark strand near the front edge, between the centre line and the PRUSA CORE One logo; easy to miss

frames.label: not clear
frames.note: the failed block and two nests from spaghetti-floating-slab

frames.label: not clear
frames.note: both parts and the strands from spaghetti-debris-warning after the print was stopped
